description: **Faster history rewrites.** `scrub match`, `scrub file`, `scrub run`, `scrub squash`, and `author rewrite` read and write objects through long-running git processes instead of one git process per object, `--remap-shas-in` reads only the directories its globs can reach, and scans skip objects holding none of a pattern's fixed strings and use every core: an entire-history `scrub match --remap-shas-in` over 8,764 commits went from 22 minutes to 34 seconds.
